preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is a positive integer within the range 1 to 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the adjacency list adj are distinct integers in the range 0 to V-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(neighbors) == 0 or all(u != v for u in neighbors) for v, neighbors in enumerate(adj))
preconditions.description: The graph has no self-loops (no node points to itself).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the returned list are valid vertices in the range 0 to V-1.

postconditions.expression: all(node not in adj[node] for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: No node in the returned list has a self-loop (though the graph is guaranteed to have no self-loops, this is a redundant check for clarity).

postconditions.expression: all(any(not adj[node] for node in path) or all(adj[node] and all(adj[node][0] in path for node in path)) for node in return_value for path in paths_from_node(node, adj))
postconditions.description: For every node in the returned list, every possible path starting from that node leads to a terminal node (a node with no outgoing edges).
The returned list of safe nodes is sorted in ascending order.
